findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, describe, ai_translate, ai_extract_json, ai_answer, ai_summarize, ai_translate_text, llm_chat, llm_inference, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_classify · Private data: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_rerank, ai_translate_text, llm_chat, llm_inference, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1 · Public sink: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, image, ai_summarize_text, ai_rerank, ai_summarize, image_generate, llm_chat, llm_inference, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_outline.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ai_speech" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Turn up to 1,000 characters of text into natural speech as an audio file (base64, with its content type), in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean, with MeloTTS. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank y" → after: "Turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as an MP3 (base64), in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices), with Deepgram Aura-2. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for voice replies, narration, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots. Example: text"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
